**[[Oromo conflict]]
***[[Prime Minister of Ethiopia]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] says that "citizens in the [[Oromia|Oromia region]]’s [[Kelam Welega Zone|Qellen Wellega]] area have come under a [[massacre]]" by the [[Oromo Liberation Army]].
